The Money Alpha 360 Summit 2026 is set to bring together the sharpest minds across lending, wealth, fintech, and distribution - and My Mudra Fincorp Ltd. is proud to be at the center of these conversations.

Over the years, we’ve built a strong presence across India with 170+ offices, helping lakhs of customers access the right financial solutions — faster, smarter, and more efficiently.

But the industry is evolving.
Today, finance is no longer just about products, it’s about speed, data, and distribution at scale.
And platforms like this summit are where the future gets discussed, debated, and built.
📍 Visit us at Stall No.: H2-SP23 – H2-SP22
 📅 24–25 April 2026 | India Expo Centre, Greater Noida.

Whether you are a lender, distributor, fintech partner, or investor —
this is where meaningful partnerships begin.

We look forward to meeting you, exchanging ideas, and exploring opportunities together.
Let’s build the next phase of India’s financial growth.

🔈Insigneo at the Funds Society Leaders Summit – Miami 

Our CEO & Chairman, Henriquez Raul, as well as Ahmed Riesgo, CIO, took the stage at the Funds Society Leaders Summit, sharing insights on the markets and the evolving wealth management landscape. 

A special mention to Maria Hebdritch for receiving the Lifetime Achievement Award, a well-deserved recognition of her remarkable 30+ year career in the industry. 

Alejandro Guardiola, CFA, CAIA , Investment Solutions Product Manager, also participated as a panel moderator, contributing to the conversation across key topics discussed during the event. 

Thank you to Funds Society for the invitation and to all panelists for a great discussion. 

 #Insigneo #LeadershipSpotlight #WealthManagement #AssetManagement #FinancialServices

‘World FinTech Summit 2026’ – an honour to be on the advisory council. Sign up – it’s in two weeks! 

World FinTech Summit 2026: ‘Powering the Next Wave of Global Finance’
May 5-6, Bangalore: Sheraton Grand

India’s fintech ecosystem is regarded as the world’s third largest, and home to over 9,000 fintech companies. They reportedly account for nearly 46% of global real-time digital payment transactions. 

The 2nd World Fintech Summit (WFS) 2026 in Bengaluru promotes innovation, resilience, and collaboration across ecosystems. The state of Karnataka has solidified its positioning as a leading global fintech hub. From wealth management to financial inclusion, India’s DPI, BFSI sector, and startups have a lot to offer. 

It is an honour and delight for me to serve on the WFS Advisory Council: https://lnkd.in/gF6PAYdn

We at MXR.world (‘mixers across the world’) offer an innovation scaling platform for founders, investors, policymakers, and the broader ecosystem: https://www.mxr.world/

Sign up to participate – see you all in two weeks!

Vijaya Kadiyala Ritu Sharma Sandhya Vasudevan Deepak Sharma Atul Garg Binit Jha Dr Anuradha Bhatia Prasanna Lohar Amit Mishra 
Karnataka Digital Economy Mission (KDEM) MXR.world TiE Bangalore NSRCEL Elets Technomedia Vinay Dora K Sheraton Grand Bangalore at Brigade Gateway

Thank you, Atharv Sawant , for delivering such a powerful and application-driven learning experience at Institute of Management and Entrepreneurship Development (BVDU).

It’s truly inspiring to see our MBA students move beyond theory and actively build real-world financial models with such clarity and confidence. Sessions like these perfectly align with our philosophy of experiential learning—where concepts are not just taught, but applied.

Your approach of making finance practical, interactive, and immediately usable has left a lasting impact on our students. We are proud to have hosted a workshop that bridges the gap between classroom learning and industry expectations.

We look forward to many more such collaborations that empower our students to become future-ready professionals.

posts.content:
Honored to join today’s Diligent Leadership Summit alongside the luminaries Jean, Roosevelt, and Kristy for a timely discussion on AI strategy, investment, trust, and compliance.

One theme came through clearly: AI leadership is no longer a technology conversation — it is a governance, operating discipline, and enterprise‑value conversation. The organizations that will lead are those that embed judgment, transparency, and trust into every stage of their AI journey.

The results shared today reinforce a point I emphasized on stage: AI advantage is earned through sustained investment, disciplined execution, and responsible governance — not shortcuts. 

IBM’s trajectory under the remarkable leadership of CEO Arvind Krishna and CFO James J. Kavanaugh  reflects that playbook in action.

The combination of productivity gains, margin expansion, and accelerated innovation across AI and Quantum demonstrates how a well‑governed AI strategy directly strengthens business resilience and long‑term growth.

Grateful to share the stage with leaders who understand the seriousness of this moment. And sincere thanks to Dottie Schindlinger  and the Diligent team for convening a room committed to getting responsible AI leadership right.

#KSgems #KhwajasTake
#AI #Leadership #Governance #Trust #Compliance #BoardLeadership
